Who We Are

Built on relationships, not just sales.

We don’t just sell plants — we build lasting relationships and offer solutions for the varied needs of every customer, from individual home gardeners to landscapers and other retail nurseries sourcing wholesale.

Beyond what we grow ourselves, we bring in select varieties and decorative pots imported from China, Bangkok and Spain — so a single order can complete an entire garden, indoors and out.

“Quality plants, reliable service, and a price that respects the relationship.”

Our Care

From soil to your doorstep.

Step One

Propagation & Supervision

Every plant is grown under direct supervision in a clean, protected environment from day one.

Step Two

Loading & Observation

Plants are moved to dedicated loading sheds for a final health check before transport.

Step Three

Packing & Transport

Careful packing and our own transport arrangements protect every plant anywhere in the country.

Our Story

Three generations of cultivation,
one family name.

Gangumalla Satyanarayana & Bros has grown Sri Satyanarayana Nursery from a single plot in Kadiyapulanka into a trusted wholesale and retail destination across Andhra Pradesh.

The Family Business

Built on relationships,
not just sales.

We don’t just sell plants — we build relationships and offer solutions for the various needs of our customers, from individual home gardeners to landscapers and other retail nurseries sourcing wholesale.

Our objective is simple: make every visitor feel welcomed, appreciated, and completely satisfied — whether they reach us by phone, WhatsApp, or in person at the nursery in Kadiyapulanka village, Kadiyam Mandal.

“All varieties of plants available — some prized specimens, and some priced for everyday gardens.”
Our Values

Four pillars of excellence.

01

Uncompromising Quality

Growing the highest quality plants, raised in a clean, protected environment from propagation onward. Every plant leaves our nursery in the best possible condition.

02

Knowledgeable Team

A team that knows the plants, the soil, and the climate — and shares that knowledge freely with every customer, first-time or repeat.

03

Fair, Transparent Practice

Competitive, transparent wholesale and retail pricing, with no hidden terms. Every landscaper and repeat buyer gets the same honest service.

04

Customers as Friends

Every visitor — first-time buyer or long-standing landscaper — is treated with courtesy, respect, and genuine care.
